sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। ६३ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe triṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 63 ।।

translations.english: "Take your pleasure, O king, and drink the wine today; put away sorrow and attend to your affairs. When Rama has been sent by me to the abode of Yama, Sita shall long be submissive to you."
